def test_user_register_and_login():
    username = generate_random_string()
    password = generate_random_string()
    email = f"{username}@example.com"

    user_data = {
        "username": username,
        "password": password,
        "email": email,
        "firstName": "Test",
        "lastName": "User"
    }
    resp = requests.post(get_url("user", "/register"), json=user_data, timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"

    resp = requests.get(get_url("user", f"/customers/{username}"), timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    customer = resp.json()
    assert customer.get("username") == username
    assert customer.get("email") == email
    assert customer.get("firstName") == "Test"
    assert customer.get("lastName") == "User"

    resp = requests.get(get_url("user", "/login"), auth=(username, password), timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"

    resp = requests.post(get_url("user", "/register"), json=user_data, timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 409, f"Expected 409, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"

    resp = requests.get(get_url("user", "/login"), auth=(username, "wrongpass"), timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 401, f"Expected 401, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"

    resp = requests.delete(get_url("user", f"/customers/{username}"), timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    assert resp.json().get("status") is True

    resp = requests.get(get_url("user", f"/customers/{username}"), timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    assert resp.json().get("firstName") is None

def test_user_add_address_and_card():
    username = generate_random_string()
    password = generate_random_string()

    user_data = {
        "username": username,
        "password": password,
        "email": f"{username}@example.com",
        "firstName": "Test",
        "lastName": "User"
    }
    requests.post(get_url("user", "/register"), json=user_data, timeout=10)

    address_data = {
        "city": "Test City",
        "country": "Test Country",
        "number": "123",
        "postcode": "12345",
        "street": "Test Street",
        "userID": username
    }
    resp = requests.post(get_url("user", "/addresses"), json=address_data, timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    address_id = resp.json().get("id")
    assert address_id is not None

    resp = requests.get(get_url("user", f"/addresses/{address_id}"), timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    addr = resp.json()
    assert addr.get("city") == "Test City"
    assert addr.get("country") == "Test Country"
    assert addr.get("number") == "123"
    assert addr.get("postcode") == "12345"
    assert addr.get("street") == "Test Street"

    card_data = {
        "ccv": "123",
        "expires": "12/25",
        "longNum": "1234567890123456",
        "userID": username
    }
    resp = requests.post(get_url("user", "/cards"), json=card_data, timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    card_id = resp.json().get("id")
    assert card_id is not None

    resp = requests.get(get_url("user", f"/cards/{card_id}"), timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    card = resp.json()
    assert card.get("expires") == "12/25"
    assert card.get("longNum") == "************3456"

    resp = requests.get(get_url("user", f"/customers/{username}/addresses"), timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    addresses = resp.json().get("_embedded", {}).get("address", [])
    assert any(a.get("id") == address_id for a in addresses)

    resp = requests.get(get_url("user", f"/customers/{username}/cards"), timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    cards = resp.json().get("_embedded", {}).get("card", [])
    assert any(c.get("id") == card_id for c in cards)

    resp = requests.delete(get_url("user", f"/addresses/{address_id}"), timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"

    resp = requests.get(get_url("user", f"/customers/{username}/addresses"), timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    addresses = resp.json().get("_embedded", {}).get("address", [])
    assert not any(a.get("id") == address_id for a in addresses)

    resp = requests.delete(get_url("user", f"/cards/{card_id}"), timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"

    resp = requests.get(get_url("user", f"/customers/{username}/cards"), timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    cards = resp.json().get("_embedded", {}).get("card", [])
    assert not any(c.get("id") == card_id for c in cards)

def test_carts_add_update_remove_items():
    customer_id = str(uuid.uuid4())

    item_data = {
        "itemId": "item-1",
        "quantity": 2,
        "unitPrice": 10.5
    }
    resp = requests.post(get_url("carts", f"/carts/{customer_id}/items"), json=item_data, timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 201, f"Expected 201, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"

    resp = requests.get(get_url("carts", f"/carts/{customer_id}/items"), timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    items = resp.json()
    assert len(items) == 1
    assert items[0].get("itemId") == "item-1"
    assert items[0].get("quantity") == 2
    assert items[0].get("unitPrice") == 10.5

    update_data = {
        "itemId": "item-1",
        "quantity": 5,
        "unitPrice": 10.5
    }
    resp = requests.patch(get_url("carts", f"/carts/{customer_id}/items"), json=update_data, timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 202, f"Expected 202, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"

    resp = requests.get(get_url("carts", f"/carts/{customer_id}/items/item-1"), timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    item = resp.json()
    assert item.get("quantity") == 5

    resp = requests.delete(get_url("carts", f"/carts/{customer_id}/items/item-1"), timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 202, f"Expected 202, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"

    resp = requests.get(get_url("carts", f"/carts/{customer_id}/items/item-1"), timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 404, f"Expected 404, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"

    resp = requests.delete(get_url("carts", f"/carts/{customer_id}"), timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 202, f"Expected 202, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"

    resp = requests.get(get_url("carts", f"/carts/{customer_id}/items"), timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    assert len(resp.json()) == 0

def test_orders_create_and_search():
    username = generate_random_string()

    requests.post(get_url("user", "/register"), json={
        "username": username,
        "password": "password",
        "email": f"{username}@example.com",
        "firstName": "Test",
        "lastName": "User"
    }, timeout=10)

    resp = requests.post(get_url("user", "/addresses"), json={
        "city": "City", "country": "Country", "number": "1", "postcode": "123", "street": "Street", "userID": username
    }, timeout=10)
    address_id = resp.json().get("id")

    resp = requests.post(get_url("user", "/cards"), json={
        "ccv": "123", "expires": "12/25", "longNum": "1234567890123456", "userID": username
    }, timeout=10)
    card_id = resp.json().get("id")

    requests.post(get_url("carts", f"/carts/{username}/items"), json={
        "itemId": "sock-1", "quantity": 1, "unitPrice": 15.0
    }, timeout=10)

    order_req = {
        "customer": f"/customers/{username}",
        "address": f"/addresses/{address_id}",
        "card": f"/cards/{card_id}",
        "items": f"/carts/{username}/items"
    }
    resp = requests.post(get_url("orders", "/orders"), json=order_req, timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 201, f"Expected 201, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    order = resp.json()
    order_id = order.get("id")
    assert order_id is not None
    assert order.get("customer", {}).get("username") == username
    assert len(order.get("items", [])) == 1
    assert order.get("total") == 15.0

    resp = requests.get(get_url("orders", f"/orders/{order_id}"), timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    fetched_order = resp.json()
    assert fetched_order.get("id") == order_id

    resp = requests.get(get_url("orders", f"/orders/search/customerId?custId={username}"), timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    customer_orders = resp.json().get("_embedded", {}).get("customerOrders", [])
    assert any(o.get("id") == order_id for o in customer_orders)
